mapper.select:
select t.* from (select hac.class_head_id, hac.batch_num, hac.class_year, hac.class_season, hac.description, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'QUARTER' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = hac.class_season) class_season_n, hac.submit_by, (select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id = hac.submit_by) submit_by_n, hac.unit_id, (select fou.unit_name from fnd_org_unit fou where fou.unit_id = hac.unit_id) unit_id_n, hac.approve_time, to_char(hac.approve_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') approve_time_n, hac.approve_status, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'HLS_WFL_STATUS' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = hac.approve_status) approve_status_n, hac.bp_id, (SELECT HBM.BP_NAME FROM HLS_BP_MASTER HBM WHERE HBM.BP_ID = HAC.BP_ID) bp_name, hac.document_type, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'HLS_ASSET_CLASS_HEAD_TYPE' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = hac.document_type) DOCUMENT_TYPE_N, nvl((select count(HACL.class_line_id) from HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HACL where HACL.class_head_id = hac.class_head_id), 0) CONTRACT_QUANTITY, --合同数量 nvl((select count(HACL.class_line_id) from HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HACL where HACL.class_head_id = hac.class_head_id and HACL.review_level in ('0', '1')), 0) normal_quantity, --正常数量 nvl((select sum(HACL.remaining_rent) from HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HACL where HACL.class_head_id = hac.class_head_id and HACL.review_level in ('0', '1')), 0) NORMAL_SURPLUS_RENTAL, --正常剩余租金 nvl((select count(HACL.class_line_id) from HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HACL where HACL.class_head_id = hac.class_head_id and HACL.review_level in ('2', '3')), 0) SPECIAL_MENTION_QUANTITY, --关注数量 nvl((select sum(HACL.remaining_rent) from HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HACL where HACL.class_head_id = hac.class_head_id and HACL.review_level in ('2', '3')), 0) SPECIAL_MENTION_SUR_REN, --关注剩余租金 nvl((select count(HACL.class_line_id) from HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HACL where HACL.class_head_id = hac.class_head_id and HACL.review_level in ('4')), 0) SUBSTANDARD_QUANTITY, --次级数量 nvl((select sum(HACL.remaining_rent) from HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HACL where HACL.class_head_id = hac.class_head_id and HACL.review_level in ('4')), 0) SUBSTANDARD_SURPLUS_RENTAL, --次级剩余租金 nvl((select count(HACL.class_line_id) from HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HACL where HACL.class_head_id = hac.class_head_id and HACL.review_level in ('5')), 0) DOUBTFUL_QUANTITY, --可疑数量 nvl((select sum(HACL.remaining_rent) from HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HACL where HACL.class_head_id = hac.class_head_id and HACL.review_level in ('5')), 0) DOUBTFUL_SURPLUS_RENTAL, --可疑剩余租金 nvl((select count(HACL.class_line_id) from HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HACL where HACL.class_head_id = hac.class_head_id and HACL.review_level = '6'), 0) LOSS_QUANTITY, --损失数量 nvl((select sum(HACL.remaining_rent) from HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HACL where HACL.class_head_id = hac.class_head_id and HACL.review_level = '6'), 0) LOSS_SURPLUS_RENTAL --损失剩余租金 from hls_asset_class_head hac ) t
and t.class_head_id = #{classHeadId}

SELECT hac.*, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'QUARTER' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = hac.class_season) class_season_n FROM hls_asset_class_head hac where hac.class_head_id = #{classHeadId}

select hac.class_head_id, hac.batch_num, hac.class_year, hac.class_season, hac.description, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'QUARTER' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = hac.class_season) class_season_n, hac.submit_by, (select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id = hac.submit_by) submit_by_n, hac.unit_id, (select fou.unit_name from fnd_org_unit fou where fou.unit_id = hac.unit_id) unit_id_n, hac.approve_time, to_char(hac.approve_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') approve_time_n, hac.approve_status, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'HLS_WFL_STATUS' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = hac.approve_status) approve_status_n, hac.bp_id, (SELECT HBM.BP_NAME FROM HLS_BP_MASTER HBM WHERE HBM.BP_ID = HAC.BP_ID) bp_name, hac.document_type, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'HLS_ASSET_CLASS_HEAD_TYPE' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = hac.document_type) DOCUMENT_TYPE_N, nvl((select count(HACL.class_line_id) from HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HACL where HACL.class_head_id = hac.class_head_id), 0) CONTRACT_QUANTITY, --合同数量 nvl((select count(HACL.class_line_id) from HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HACL where HACL.class_head_id = hac.class_head_id and HACL.approve_review_level in ('NORMAL_ONE', 'NORMAL_TWO', 'NORMAL_THREE','NORMAL_FOUR')), 0) normal_quantity, --正常数量 nvl((select sum(HACL.remaining_rent) from HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HACL where HACL.class_head_id = hac.class_head_id and HACL.approve_review_level in ('NORMAL_ONE', 'NORMAL_TWO', 'NORMAL_THREE','NORMAL_FOUR')), 0) NORMAL_SURPLUS_RENTAL, --正常剩余租金 nvl((select count(HACL.class_line_id) from HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HACL where HACL.class_head_id = hac.class_head_id and HACL.approve_review_level in ('SPECIAL_MENTION_ONE', 'SPECIAL_MENTION_TWO', 'SPECIAL_MENTION_THREE')), 0) SPECIAL_MENTION_QUANTITY, --关注数量 nvl((select sum(HACL.remaining_rent) from HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HACL where HACL.class_head_id = hac.class_head_id and HACL.approve_review_level in ('SPECIAL_MENTION_ONE', 'SPECIAL_MENTION_TWO', 'SPECIAL_MENTION_THREE')), 0) SPECIAL_MENTION_SUR_REN, --关注剩余租金 nvl((select count(HACL.class_line_id) from HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HACL where HACL.class_head_id = hac.class_head_id and HACL.approve_review_level in ('SUBSTANDARD_ONE', 'SUBSTANDARD_TWO')), 0) SUBSTANDARD_QUANTITY, --次级数量 nvl((select sum(HACL.remaining_rent) from HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HACL where HACL.class_head_id = hac.class_head_id and HACL.approve_review_level in ('SUBSTANDARD_ONE', 'SUBSTANDARD_TWO')), 0) SUBSTANDARD_SURPLUS_RENTAL, --次级剩余租金 nvl((select count(HACL.class_line_id) from HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HACL where HACL.class_head_id = hac.class_head_id and HACL.approve_review_level in ('DOUBTFUL_ONE', 'DOUBTFUL_TWO')), 0) DOUBTFUL_QUANTITY, --可疑数量 nvl((select sum(HACL.remaining_rent) from HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HACL where HACL.class_head_id = hac.class_head_id and HACL.approve_review_level in ('DOUBTFUL_ONE', 'DOUBTFUL_TWO')), 0) DOUBTFUL_SURPLUS_RENTAL, --可疑剩余租金 nvl((select count(HACL.class_line_id) from HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HACL where HACL.class_head_id = hac.class_head_id and HACL.approve_review_level = 'LOSS'), 0) LOSS_QUANTITY, --损失数量 nvl((select sum(HACL.remaining_rent) from HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HACL where HACL.class_head_id = hac.class_head_id and HACL.approve_review_level = 'LOSS'), 0) LOSS_SURPLUS_RENTAL --损失剩余租金 from hls_asset_class_head hac
and hac.class_head_id = #{classHeadId}
